alternatives.name: LARGE_TRANSACTION_WHALE_EVENT_WITH_SIZE_NORMALIZATION
tradeoffs: Size ratios are normalized to rolling volume or ADV references; no universal dollar whale threshold.

negative: Direction remains ambiguous unless side and threshold gate are both explicit; below-threshold prints must be surfaced honestly.
positive: large_transactions family can surface entitled fixture prints without collapsing into a universal whale score.

decision.summary: Large-transaction whale events use whale_event payloads with family large_transactions, print_size, price, side (buy|sell|unknown), reference_type (rolling_volume|adv), reference_value, size_ratio (DERIVED), threshold_gate result, direction_label (supports_long|supports_short|neutral|ambiguous), and aggressor_provenance (known|unknown|inferred). PIT queries exclude events whose available_time exceeds prediction_cutoff. Large prints are not trader intent.
decision.title: Large transaction whale envelope semantics and size normalization

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Acceptance authorizes fixture-first large_transactions on ADMITTED-LARGE-PRINTS-NVDA-001 only. Live tape adapters and order_book families require separate entitlement records.
